note: Both sets capture the core rotor figures (5 rpm minimum speed with the 3P rationale, 7.55 rpm rated speed, 95 m/s tip speed, 0° pitch at design TSR, 10.59 m/s rated wind speed, and the three control regions), and both make the same misbinding of the DTU partial-load poles to the pitch controller. Set B adds useful facts A omits (pitching starts at 10.59 m/s, PI torque control, the Region 2.5 cause) but also commits harder errors: it reports partial-load-pole damping as 0.03 Hz (that is the full-load natural frequency), binds a wind-speed range to the attribute 'minimum rotor speed', and alters two DTU pole quotes. Set A's faults are a misbound pole claim, one fabricated quote ('P3'), an invented 'steady-state' condition and one truncated quote, plus heavy duplication of the 5 rpm and 0° pitch claims; it also keeps the positive-pitch-at-low-wind fact that B drops. On balance A has fewer wrong or unsupported claims, though neither set is clean.
